visualCharacteristics.purpose: short feature facts, each a small line icon above one line of text
visualCharacteristics.layout: 2 columns from 744px (2x2 for four items), 1 column on mobile

usage: Program / role highlight grids in the split sections of the New Graduates page.
reuseGuidance: Use for icon + short-text facts without titles or links. For a stacked list of check-marked statements use cards-checklist.
